description: Shared executable-graph baseline for the storage-independent substrate study. Nodes carry executable content (an accumulator operation); directional edges carry condition properties for result-dependent routing. The 'grow' node has NO outgoing edge in the baseline: the agent grows the substrate's continuation by self-modifying it during execution, then traverses the newly created topology. This same baseline is the shared fixture for STUDY-203 (ADR-003); whichever study lands first authors it byte-identically.
